audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping and retrospective RNA-conditioned ATAC

multivi_local.corpus: No upstream pretraining corpus; only declared outer-training donor RNA/ATAC matrices

interpretation: Locally trained MultiVI avoids foundation-checkpoint contamination if every fitted object stays inside its outer donor fold. The dominant leakage risks are held-donor peak unions, gene/region filtering, data-dependent dimensions, categorical batches, query updating, early stopping, calibration, and confusing structural missingness with zero. Unmodified scvi-tools infers modality presence from nonzero row sums, which does not meet the explicit-mask project requirements.
remaining_blockers: Implement and review an explicit missing-modality-mask adapter or obtain a documented project contract exception; prove observed all-zero and structurally missing rows remain distinguishable.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well/reference/peak/QC and same-nucleus joins pass.
Freeze outer-training-only genes, peaks, preprocessing, explicit hidden/latent dimensions, modality weights, allowed covariates, heads, early stopping, calibration, and five seeds.
Prohibit cell modality weights and load_query_data on held or sealed rows; prevent donor IDs from becoming unseen batch categories.
Prove the RNA-only profile fixture passes no observed held-row ATAC to prepare, fit, predict, or calibration code.
Validate scvi-tools 1.5.0.post1 import, sparse MuData path, forward/backward, checkpoint resume, deterministic seeds, cross-device tolerance, and memory on L40S.
Confirm that GSE289173 RNA features can be aligned without any sealed-label or checkpoint exposure and that no ATAC claim is made on this RNA-only seal.
sealed_champion_eligibility: blocked_pending_explicit_mask_data_runtime_and_profile_fixtures; cell-state eligible in principle on GSE289173, RNA-conditioned ATAC remains retrospective without an ATAC seal
